mainEntity.name: Why hire a Super Grade Licensed Electrical Contractor in Bengaluru, Karnataka?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Super Grade License issued by the Government of Karnataka Electrical Inspectorate authorizes the contractor to execute Low Tension (LT), High Tension (11kV/33kV), and Extra High Tension (66kV/110kV+) electrical works, and represent clients directly for CEIG drawing sanctions and BESCOM/KPTCL safety clearances.

mainEntity.name: Where is Ananya Electrical Solutions located and which areas in Karnataka do you serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our headquarters is located at 59, Opp Bank of India, G-Block, Sahakarnagar Main Road, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560092. We serve all major industrial, commercial, and residential zones across Bengaluru (Sahakarnagar, Hebbal, Yelahanka, Peenya, Whitefield, Electronic City, Bommasandra, Devanahalli, Hosakote) and all 31 districts of Karnataka.

mainEntity.name: How long does CEIG drawing sanction and BESCOM power approval take?

acceptedAnswer.text: With complete Single Line Diagrams (SLD), equipment layout clearances, and NABL-calibrated earth resistance/insulation test reports prepared by our engineering team, CEIG drawing sanction typically takes 10 to 14 working days, followed by final safety inspection and energization approval within 5 to 7 working days.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide turnkey rooftop solar installation with BESCOM Net Metering in Bengaluru?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We provide complete rooftop and ground-mounted solar EPC services for factories, commercial buildings, apartments, and independent homes, including Tier-1 bifacial solar panels, string/hybrid inverters, CEIG solar clearance, and BESCOM bidirectional net metering.

mainEntity.name: How can I request a site visit or electrical quotation from Ananya Electrical Solutions?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can call or WhatsApp our primary engineering desk at +91 9632025123, call our 24/7 grid emergency hotline at +91 8660121438, email ananyaelectricalsolutions@gmail.com, or submit the online engineering quotation form on our website.
